response.sql: WITH t AS (SELECT DISTINCT tr.transreg, td.tradekind FROM advancedbehavior ab JOIN transactionrecord tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg JOIN trader td ON tr.trdref = td.tradereg), c AS (SELECT tradekind, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM t GROUP BY tradekind), s AS (SELECT tradekind, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share FROM c), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT s.tradekind, s.cnt AS transaction_count, s.share AS share, s.share - a.avg_share AS share_minus_avg FROM s CROSS JOIN a WHERE a.avg_share IS NOT NULL AND s.share > a.avg_share
